name: abap2ui5-samples-stack
description: Learn how abap2UI5 plays with your stack - OData, Smart Controls, RAP (with draft), business events, stateful sessions and locks, AMC/APC, MIME and the Fiori Launchpad.

scripts.check: npm run check:pin && npm run lint && npm run check:abap2ui5 && npm run check:overview && npm run check:keywords && npm run check:titles && npm run check:abapdoc && npm run check:samples-md && npm run check:catalogue && npm run check:app-rules && npm run check:atc && npm run check:prose && npm run check:derived && npm run check:released-api && npm run check:702 && npm run rename

renameSkip.src/03/: RAP: the CDS root entity Z2UI5_R_SMPS_TRV and its behavior definition - abaplint 2.120.120 renames no DDLS/BDEF (abap2UI5 backlog item abaplint-rename-cds-rap), nor the EML that names them
renameSkip.src/04/: RAP with Draft: the CDS root entity and behavior definition - abaplint 2.120.120 renames no DDLS/BDEF (abap2UI5 backlog item abaplint-rename-cds-rap), nor the EML that names them
renameSkip.src/05/: Business Events: CDS entities, behavior definitions, a service definition and binding (SRVD, SRVB) and an event binding (G4BA) - abaplint 2.120.120 renames no DDLS/BDEF (abap2UI5 backlog item abaplint-rename-cds-rap), nor the EML that names them, nor SRVD/SRVB/G4BA (abaplint-rename-cds-rap, abaplint-rename-gateway-objects)
renameSkip.src/06/: Stateful Sessions / Locks: its table z2ui5_t_smps_01 has 15 characters and a transparent table at most 16, so a name longer than 6 characters pushes it over (renaming the table is breaking); the lock samples also name it in three literals - abap2UI5 backlog item samples-rename-semantics
renameSkip.src/07/: AMC/APC: the APC application (SAPC), the AMC channel (SAMC), their authorization defaults (SUSH) and the ICF node name the handler class and the channel - abaplint 2.120.120 renames none of them (abaplint-rename-connectivity-mime-objects, abaplint-rename-authorization-objects)
renameSkip.src/08/: MIME: the class plays the two MIME objects (SMIM) of src/08/01, which abaplint 2.120.120 cannot rename (abaplint-rename-connectivity-mime-objects)
renameSkip.src/10/: AI / LLM: its table z2ui5_t_smps_llm has 16 characters, the most a transparent table may have, so any name longer than z2ui5 pushes it over (renaming the table is breaking); z2ui5_cl_smps_llm_factory also creates its three transports by name from literals - abap2UI5 backlog item samples-rename-semantics
renameSkip.src/11/: RAP File Upload: CDS entities and behavior definitions - abaplint 2.120.120 renames no DDLS/BDEF (abap2UI5 backlog item abaplint-rename-cds-rap), nor the EML that names them
renameSkip.src/12/: RAP Actions & Permissions: CDS entities and behavior definitions - abaplint 2.120.120 renames no DDLS/BDEF (abap2UI5 backlog item abaplint-rename-cds-rap), nor the EML that names them
renameSkip.src/13/: Excel & E-Mail: creates travels in the RAP business object of src/03 with EML, so it goes where src/03 goes (abaplint-rename-cds-rap)
